# Watch Gang

> > Watch Gang is the world's largest watch subscription club, offering monthly curated timepieces from brands like Seiko, Citizen, Tissot, and TAG Heuer across multiple membership tiers with gamified wheel-spin selections.

Watch Gang operates a tiered membership system (Original, Black, Platinum, Premium, Luxury, Sport) that delivers automatic, quartz, and Swiss movement watches to collectors monthly. Members participate in weekly luxury giveaways for brands like Rolex and TAG Heuer, while the gamified 'Wheel' system guarantees minimum value watches from emerging and established brands.

## Key Topics

- Watch subscription service
- Membership tiers (Original, Black, Platinum, Premium, Luxury, Sport)
- Automatic watches and Swiss movement
- Japanese movement timepieces
- Luxury watch brands (Rolex, TAG Heuer, Tissot, Seiko, Citizen)
- Wheel-spin gamification system
- Monthly watch delivery
- Beginner watch collectors
- Quartz movement watches
- Watch club membership
- Luxury giveaways
- Emerging watch brands (Hemel, RGMT, Melbourne Watch Co., Breda)
- Entry-level to premium subscriptions
- Dive watches and sport watches

## Subscription Plans & Membership Tiers

- [Memberships – Watch Gang](https://www.watchgang.com/subscription-plans): Overview of all Watch Gang membership tiers and subscription plans
- [Watch Gang Black Subscription](https://www.watchgang.com/subscription-plans/black-tier): Black tier subscription with Swiss/Japanese automatic watches like Seiko
- [Watch Gang Platinum Subscription](https://www.watchgang.com/subscription-plans/platinum-tier): Premium Platinum tier featuring luxury automatic watches with Swiss movement
- [Watch Gang Original Subscription](https://www.watchgang.com/subscription-plans/original-tier): Entry-level Original tier subscription for beginner watch collectors
